verdict.rationale: AutoGen's AgentChat docs list a Memory section to "add memory capabilities to your agents," so the framework offers some agent memory. Nothing in the pack shows that this memory persists across sessions or threads, or what storage backs it. missing for 10: evidence of cross-session/cross-thread persistence, documented persistent memory backends (e.g. vector store or database), memory scoping per user or thread, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
